title: Enquiry form refuses an incomplete enquiry and keeps your typing

steps.expect: The form returns with "Please add a client (pick one, or type a name); the contact person; a contact e-mail or mobile; the Business Unit (business unit); a subject." No enquiry created.
steps.observed: Refused: "Please add a client (pick one, or type a name); the contact person; a contact e-mail or mobile; the business unit (business unit); a subject." No enquiry created.
steps.note: The message reads "Please add a client (pick one, or type a name); the contact person; a contact e-mail or mobile; the business unit (business unit); a subject." (lower-case "business unit", which then repeats itself in brackets).

steps.do: Fill everything except e-mail and mobile.
steps.expect: Refused: needs "a contact e-mail or mobile". Everything else you typed is still there.
steps.observed: Refused: "Please add a contact e-mail or mobile."; client, contact, subject and details still there.

steps.do: Give a mobile but no e-mail.
steps.expect: Accepted — e-mail OR mobile is enough.
steps.observed: Accepted with a mobile and no e-mail: "INQ-00001 created. You can now raise a quotation against it."
steps.note: After the refusal the form's button reads "Save inquiry" instead of "Create inquiry".

steps.do: Received date in the future (next month).
steps.expect: Record what happens — ideally a warning; the enquiry must not count as overdue.
steps.observed: Refused: "Nothing has been saved — Received date cannot be after 15 Nov 2026. | ⚠ This date is in the future. An inquiry can only be recorded as received today or earlier — it will not be saved."
steps.reason: The test asks to record what happens; the owner decides whether a future received date is refused or only warned.
steps.proposed: Refuse a received date in the future ("an enquiry cannot have arrived after today"), as the app now does (commit "enquiry date not in the future"); if it is ever allowed, it must never count as overdue.

steps.do: Received date 90 days ago with Status Open.
steps.expect: The register shows a red "⏳ 90d" overdue pill.
steps.observed: The register shows a red "⏳ 90d" pill on the row.
